title: Balanced Light Control Framework workflow
source: Local manuscript methods and user-specified control rules
layout: Left-to-right five-stage flow with GA feedback loop
alt_text: A five-stage workflow moves from sky condition, occupancy count, and seat distribution through an office model and three lighting-control strategies to illuminance, comfort, and power evaluation, followed by matched comparisons. A dashed feedback arrow links evaluation to the GA-derived strategy to show penalty-based evolution.
